scope_limits: Broad materials basket, not plant-specific input prices.
Broad manufacturing output WPI single-deflates reported VA; no double-deflated VA.
Capital-goods WPI is a coarse proxy for heterogeneous nonland assets, especially buildings and major repairs; not asset-specific replacement costs or capital services.
Temporary local PDFs/screenshots are source receipts, not silently published firm inputs. Stable BPS publication URLs and source hashes remain the portable locators.
